criteria.statement: HiveCI workflow-run events decode repo, commit, branch, workflow, trigger, publisher, and provenance into Bahia's HiveCI workflow-run domain model.
HiveCI workflow-result events decode status, exit code, duration, log URL, image metadata, and errors into Bahia's HiveCI workflow-result domain model.
HiveCI run/result projections include a quality-gate payload that marks running checks, passing checks, and merge-blocking failures.
